title: Alien
facts: Alien was Ridley Scott's second feature film, after The Duellists (1977).
Dan O'Bannon wrote the screenplay, from a story by O'Bannon and Ronald Shusett.
Swiss artist H. R. Giger designed the alien creature.
Alien won the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects.
The ship is the commercial towing vessel Nostromo. It shares its name with a 1904 novel by Joseph Conrad.
Bolaji Badejo, a very tall Nigerian design student, played the alien.
Ripley was Sigourney Weaver's first leading role in a film.
The ship's cat is named Jones.
The film's tagline was "In space no one can hear you scream."
Much of the film was shot at Shepperton Studios in England.
The crew call the ship's computer "Mother".
In 2002 the Library of Congress selected Alien for the National Film Registry.
Ian Holm plays Ash, the ship's science officer.
An early title for Dan O'Bannon's script was "Star Beast".
James Cameron directed the sequel, Aliens, released in 1986.
John Hurt later spoofed his own famous scene from this film in Spaceballs (1987).
Alien opened in the United States on May 25, 1979.
